documentation.title: Group Use Trailing Comma
documentation.standard: For single-line group use statements, there should be no comma after the last import.

code.title: Valid: No comma after the last import.
Invalid: Comma after the last import.

documentation.standard: For multi-line group use statements, there should be a comma after the last import.

code.title: Valid: Comma after the last import.
Invalid: No comma after the last import.
